metadata.description: Official marketplace for gimme-the-lint - polyglot progressive linting with per-app baselines and drift detection

plugins.name: gimme-the-lint
plugins.description: Polyglot progressive linting for monorepos — adapter-driven baselines, per-app drift detection, and idempotent skips. Supports JavaScript/TypeScript (ESLint, Biome), Python (Ruff), Go (golangci-lint), Rust (Clippy), Terraform/OpenTofu (tflint), and Ansible (ansible-lint).
